nodes.label: RAJAGP Client (this repository)
nodes.rationale: Operator application: track and vehicle visualization, lap and sector timing, race control and the Pit Wall PRO screen. Published by RAJAGP SIA, version 1.1.

nodes.label: RAJAGP Server (Track Server)
nodes.rationale: Closed repository that receives tracker telemetry, computes authoritative positions and laps, serves clients over WebSocket, and hosts the shared rajagp_core protocol library.

nodes.label: Tracker (onboard ESP32 + GPS/RTK transmitter)
nodes.rationale: On-vehicle module collecting coordinates and telemetry and transmitting them over LoRa (SX1280) radio.

nodes.label: Ground receiver (LoRa to USB COM)
nodes.rationale: Ground module that receives radio packets from trackers and hands them to the client over a USB COM port.

nodes.label: Local mode (COM port, no server)
nodes.rationale: The SX1280/LoRa receiver plugs straight into the PC; ports are auto-discovered in the background and picked from a menu, so no server is required.

nodes.label: Network mode (Track Server over WebSocket)
nodes.rationale: Native WinHTTP WebSocket - chosen without third-party socket libraries specifically so it also runs on ARM64; the server supplies track geometry, vehicle states and authoritative timings while the client watches packet loss and jitter.

nodes.label: Built-in simulator
nodes.rationale: Generates vehicles on the track for testing without hardware.

nodes.label: OpenGL track visualization
nodes.rationale: OpenGL 3.3 track map (asphalt, kerbs, 20 m grid) with a zoom/rotate/inertia camera, plus real-time vehicles with motion interpolation, name labels and a timeout for vanished trackers.

nodes.label: Race flags (green / yellow / red / finish)
nodes.rationale: Flags can be raised locally or synchronised from the server.

nodes.label: PRO mode (Pit Wall floating panels)
nodes.rationale: A separate screen of floating panels (Laptime, Lap List, Lap Info, Sectors, Track Map, G-Force, Channels, Events) with layout locking and per-panel text zoom (Ctrl+wheel); channel scales persist in pro_scales.ini and layout in imgui.ini.

nodes.label: Track recording from telemetry
nodes.rationale: A tracker-equipped vehicle drives one lap; the client records the trajectory, closes the loop and smooths it with a spline.

nodes.label: Dual-edge track creation (README)
nodes.rationale: Drive the left edge, then the right edge, producing a track with real borders stored as binary .trk2 (header plus two polylines, UTM georeferencing via GeographicLib).

nodes.label: Roles and admin tokens (Networking -> Accounts)
nodes.rationale: user/admin roles selected by the token entered on connect; the admin controls the race and issues 1-hour / 1-day / permanent access tokens, copyable by click.

nodes.label: Hotkeys (F1, Shift+C, Ctrl+S, Ctrl+P, Ctrl+wheel, Esc)
Inno Setup installer
nodes.rationale: Packs x64\Release (exe plus all DLLs including the VC++ CRT), assets and a Mesa3D fallback for software OpenGL on VMs/RDP/old GPUs, and installs the VC++ Redistributable when needed; paths inside the script are relative and output lands in installer/out/.

nodes.label: OpenGL/src module layout
nodes.rationale: core / input / logging / network / racing / rendering / track / ui / vehicle, with src as the single header root so files can move between directories without rewriting neighbours' includes.
